name: Maxillary right central incisor

facts.hallmark: Broad incisor crown; the mesioincisal angle is usually sharper than the distoincisal angle.
facts.compare: Usually broader and less rounded than the maxillary lateral incisor.

provenance: Measured hard-tissue geometry segmented from a consented CBCT at 0.16 mm isotropic resolution.

name: Maxillary right lateral incisor

facts.hallmark: Usually smaller and more rounded than the maxillary central incisor; lingual anatomy can be more pronounced.
facts.compare: More rounded and usually narrower than the maxillary central incisor.

provenance: Measured hard-tissue geometry segmented from a consented CBCT at 0.16 mm isotropic resolution.

name: Maxillary right canine

facts.hallmark: Single prominent cusp, robust crown, strong labial ridge and pronounced lingual anatomy.
facts.compare: Bulkier and more lingually sculpted than the mandibular canine.

provenance: Measured hard-tissue geometry segmented from a consented CBCT at 0.16 mm isotropic resolution.

name: Maxillary right first premolar

facts.roots: Often two roots or bifurcated root anatomy; variation occurs.
facts.hallmark: Mesial marginal groove and mesial crown/root depression are classic distinguishing clues.
facts.compare: Usually more angular and more likely to bifurcate than the maxillary second premolar.

provenance: Measured hard-tissue geometry segmented from a consented CBCT at 0.16 mm isotropic resolution.

name: Maxillary right second premolar

facts.hallmark: Buccal and lingual cusps are more similar in height and the occlusal outline is generally more rounded.
facts.compare: Usually rounder and less angular than the maxillary first premolar.

provenance: Measured hard-tissue geometry segmented from a consented CBCT at 0.16 mm isotropic resolution.

name: Maxillary right first molar

facts.hallmark: Four major cusps, an oblique ridge, and sometimes a cusp of Carabelli on the mesiolingual cusp.
facts.compare: Usually larger with more divergent roots than the maxillary second molar.

provenance: Measured hard-tissue geometry segmented from a consented CBCT at 0.16 mm isotropic resolution.

name: Maxillary right second molar
